commands.command: cargo clippy --lib --all-features -- -D warnings -D unsafe_code -D clippy::unwrap_used -D clippy::expect_used -D clippy::panic -D clippy::todo -D clippy::unimplemented -D clippy::indexing_slicing -D clippy::as_conversions

rules_satisfied: No lossy as conversion: replaced payload.len() as u32 with u32::try_from(payload.len()).map_err()
No unchecked payload size: added payload.len() > max_payload guard returning FrameError::PayloadTooLarge
Checked capacity arithmetic: capacity computed via checked_add
Fallible allocation: try_reserve used with map_err to FrameError::Allocation
Smallest production change: only encode_frame body modified
residual_risk: None. All Holzman absolute laws satisfied: no unsafe, no lossy casts, no unchecked access, checked arithmetic, typed errors, bounded allocation.
